messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning a small PLG experiment next week to test credit messaging + onboarding prompt templates. Goal: +10% day-7 activation without increasing $/activated user. running lightweight cohorts by signup source.
john: timeline? what channels? :eyes:
maria: kickoff Wed 09:30 PT, run 7 days. channels = product banner, welcome email, in-app toast. cohorts split by UTM_source (organic, github, webinar).
eli: proposed copy variants? we should keep CTA consistent.
maria: initial draft below — want quick feedback. we’ll A/B/C test copy + 3 prompt templates in the onboarding flow.
--- COPY VARIANTS ---
copy_A: "Welcome to Redwood — we've added $15 in credits so you can try high-throughput inference. Start with these starter prompts."
copy_B: "$15 credit waiting — build a quick prototype in minutes. Try these prompts made for product teams."
copy_C: "Kick off faster: $15 of credits and curated prompt templates to prove value in one session."
--- SEGMENT RULE (for rollout) ---
```
segment: {
  include: (utm_source == "github") || (utm_campaign == "hackathon")
  bucket_by: user_id % 3  # A/B/C
  credit_amount: 1500  # tokens (~$15)
}
```
--- PROMPT TEMPLATES (onboarding carousel) ---
1) "Generate a 3-bullet product pitch for a new feature that uses LLM embeddings."
2) "Turn these user feedback bullets into a prioritized roadmap (high/med/low)."
3) "Rewrite this API README for a junior engineer in 5 bullets."

sana: we need instrumentation: event names, funnel stages, and alert thresholds. I can add tracking if you freeze the copy + templates by EOD Tue.
maria: yep — copy freeze Tue 6pm PT. sana to own tracking.
alex: subject line ideas for welcome email?
eli: "Try Redwood — $15 credits to prototype inference" and variant: "Your Redwood credits are ready — start building"
john: can we try a more product-focused subject for devs: "Build a PoC with $15 of Redwood credits"
sam: small ask — include a quick one-click example in the email that injects the prompt template into the playground. lowers activation friction.\aria(not real): :thumbsup:  <-- accidental reaction (ignore)
analytics-bot: Dashboard created: https://analytics.internal/redwood/experiments/18325 — cohort metrics (DAU, day-1/day-7 activation, cost per activated) will populate after rollout.
eli: measurement plan: primary = day-7 activation (>=1 completed inference + token usage > 500). secondary = time-to-first-inference, retention at 14d.
sana: alert if cost per activated > 2x baseline or if univariate lift < 2% after 3 days.
maria: decision: run A/B/C copy + rotate templates across buckets, email + in-app + product-banner. sam to implement email one-click, eli + john to wire copy into banner.
sam: noted — will scaffold email button and example payload. ETA Tue EOD.
eli: I’ll update the banner components in the console and add variant IDs.
sana: I’ll add the analytics events and a quick dashboard card.
john: docs needed for CS — one-pager summarizing experiment + rollback instructions. I can draft.
maria: thanks. owners: sana (tracking), sam (email), eli (banner), john (cs doc). check-in Thu 10am PT.
alex: quick idea — if github-sourced users convert significantly better, we can expand credits to that cohort in dedicated next month.
maria: good call. if conversion lift >15% and cost per activated < baseline * 1.5, scale.
eli: small wording nit — change "credits" to "$15 credit" in copy_B to be explicit.
maria: done. final ask: keep messages tight in the doc; we’ll post the experiment summary in #growth after launch. :rocket: 
sam: :thumbsup:
john: :eyes:
analytics-bot: Experiment scheduled: 2026-04-03 16:30:00 UTC. Metrics will backfill within 2h post-launch.
